about.title2: Honest Material. Direct from the Owner.
about.subtitle: We're not a 15,000-ton mill. We're a small family workshop in Ningbo that turns clean small-home-appliance scrap into reliable recycled pellets, one container at a time.
about.storyTitle: From a Side Yard to a Working Pellet Line
about.storyP1: GreenPoly started as a side yard next to a Ningbo small-appliance assembly plant. We collected their off-spec injection runs, runner scrap and edge trim, ran them back through a basic extruder, and sold the pellets to local toy and stationery factories.
about.storyP2: Ten years later we're still small — one pelletizing line for ABS / HIPS, one for PP, one shared line for GPPS. About 300 tons a month total. But the input source stayed the same: clean, segregated, traceable scrap from named home-appliance export factories around Beilun and Cixi.
about.storyP3: What changed is the buyer side. Today we ship containers to compounders, injection molders and traders in Vietnam, Indonesia, India, Pakistan, Türkiye, Egypt and the EU. Same workshop, same boss on WhatsApp, same input material — just packed for the world.
about.sourcingTitle: Where Our Pellets Actually Come From
about.sourcingP1: Most "recycled pellets" on Alibaba are blended from random mixed-color, mixed-grade waste — which is why the MFI swings 30% batch to batch. We don't work that way.
about.sourcingP2: Our raw input is contracted from four well-known small home-appliance export factories in Ningbo. They make products for European and North American retailers — kettles, fans, vacuum cleaners, hair dryers. The off-spec parts and edge trim they generate are clean, single-grade, single-color, and traceable to the OEM.
about.sourcingPoint1: Single-source per batch — you don't get random mixed input.
about.sourcingPoint2: Off-spec OEM scrap = the original resin grade was good quality to start with.
about.sourcingPoint3: Color is segregated at source — we don't dye over contamination.
about.sourcingPoint4: MFI typically swings less than 12% batch-to-batch on the same grade code.
about.stat1Body: About 300 tons of pellets across all four resin lines.
about.stat2Body: ABS, HIPS, PP, GPPS — focused and consistent.

quality.badge: Quality We Can Actually Stand Behind
quality.subtitle: We're a small factory, so we don't pretend to have GRS chain-of-custody and FDA letters of no objection. What we do have: clean traceable input, batch-level COA, optional third-party SGS retest, and a boss who picks up the phone.
quality.promisesTitle: What You Get with Every Container
quality.p1Body: MFI, density, ash content tested in-house on every production batch. PDF sent to your email before the container leaves the port.
quality.p2Body: For first orders or sensitive applications, we'll send a sample to SGS Ningbo and forward the report. You pay the lab fee, we handle the logistics.
quality.p3Body: We can name the home-appliance OEM each batch's scrap came from. No mystery feedstock. Photos of the source pile available on request.
quality.p4Body: Every 25 kg bag and 1-ton FIBC carries the grade code, batch number, production date and MFI range. No "mixed PP" with no label.
quality.p5Body: FIBCs strapped to pallets, desiccant inserted for sea freight, container floor lined for clean transfer. Sounds basic — many small mills skip it.
quality.p6Body: If a batch's MFI is outside our stated tolerance, we'll send replacement bags on the next shipment or refund pro-rata. Documented in our PI terms.
quality.s1Body: We collect off-spec & edge-trim direct from contracted Ningbo home-appliance plants — by grade, by color, never mixed.
quality.s2Body: Manual sort + density float for stubborn cases. Cold wash for surface dust, hot wash only when needed.
quality.s3Body: Granulated to ~6 mm flake, hot-air dried below 0.3% moisture before extrusion.
quality.s4Body: Single-screw vented extruder with 80-mesh filter, water-cooled strand-cut pelletizer, optional twin-screw for filled grades.
quality.s5Body: MFI / density / ash sampled per batch. 25 kg PP woven bag or 1-ton FIBC. Grade label sealed before storage.
quality.honestBody: We don't hold GRS, FDA, RoHS or REACH SVHC certificates — those audits cost more than a small factory like ours can carry, and we'd rather pass that saving to you in price. If your end-customer needs those documents, we'll point you to certified mills. If they just need clean reliable recycled resin at a fair price — that's exactly what we make.
quality.ctaTitle: Want the QC Sheet for Your Grade?
quality.ctaBody: Tell us the resin and target use — we'll send the last 3 batches' COA so you can judge the spread yourself.
